products.title: Sol de Janeiro Beija Flor™ Jet Set Bodycare Gift Set

description.plain: The Sol de Janeiro Beija Flor™ Jet Set is a travel-friendly bodycare gift set designed to plump and renew the skin. This curated collection features a pink carrying pouch containing three mini-sized products: the Beija Flor™ Elasti-Cream (50ml), which uses retinol-mimicking Cacay Oil and Vegan Collagen to visibly plump skin; the Brazilian Crush Cheirosa 68 Perfume Mist (30ml) for a light floral scent; and the Beija Flor™ Skin-Renewing Body Wash (90ml).

description.plain: RMS Beauty Legendary Lip Oil is a nourishing, vanilla-flavored lip treatment that combines the hydration of a balm with the high-shine finish of a gloss. Infused with organic jojoba oil, bitter cherry seed oil, and the RMS Adaptogenic Herbal Blend, it works to soothe, balance, and revitalize dry lips. The non-sticky, lightweight formula provides rich color and can be worn alone or layered over lip color for added dimension.

description.plain: This RMS Beauty Legendary Lip Oil in the shade Alessandra is a luxurious, nourishing lip treatment that provides a vibrant color and a high-shine finish without feeling sticky. It's formulated with beneficial ingredients like Bitter Cherry Seed Oil for hydration and antioxidants, Organic Vanilla Extract for a soothing aroma, an RMS Adaptogenic Herbal Blend to balance and hydrate the skin, and Organic Jojoba Oil to mimic natural skin oils for easy absorption and protection. The product comes in a cylindrical tube with a ribbed top and features the 'rms' logo in white. It includes a doe-foot applicator for precise application.

description.plain: The Deluxe Gradual Tan is a luxurious lightweight lotion designed to enhance or extend a mousse tan for up to two weeks or to build a perfect shade on its own. It is formulated for medium‑to‑dark skin tones with antioxidant‑rich Acai Berry and Coffee Extract, hydrating Shea Butter, and a built‑in instant colour guide for precise application. The product comes in a 150 ml bottle and is sold in a solid, tinted formula that is nourishing, buildable, and suitable for adult females.

variants.title: Loving Tan 8 Hr Deluxe Gradual Self-tanning Lotion

description.plain: This is a gradual self-tanning lotion from Loving Tan, designed to provide a natural-looking, buildable tan. It's formulated for professional strength and a dark shade, offering a flawless, streak-free application that dries in as little as 60 seconds. The lotion is enriched with antioxidants to keep skin hydrated and radiant.

top_features: Features antioxidant-rich skin-care actives that leave skin ultra-hydrated and radiant

Flawless, streak-free application
Quick-drying formula dries in as little as 60 seconds

description.plain: The Hero Cosmetics Mighty Patch Variety Pack is a comprehensive acne treatment set designed for various breakout situations. This kit includes 12 Original patches for overnight whitehead reduction, 12 Invisible+ patches for discreet daytime wear, and 2 XL Surface patches for larger breakout areas. Made from hydrocolloid material, these patches work to absorb pimple gunk within 6-8 hours while shielding the skin from popping and picking to support a healing environment. The patches are dermatologist-tested and suitable for sensitive skin.
